cash_movements_kind_shape.name: cash_movements_kind_shape
cash_movements_kind_shape.value:
(
        "cash_movements"."kind" = 'sale'
        AND "cash_movements"."direction" = 'in'
        AND "cash_movements"."order_id" IS NOT NULL
        AND "cash_movements"."expense_category_id" IS NULL
      ) OR (
        "cash_movements"."kind" = 'sale_reversal'
        AND "cash_movements"."direction" = 'out'
        AND "cash_movements"."order_id" IS NOT NULL
        AND "cash_movements"."expense_category_id" IS NULL
      ) OR (
        "cash_movements"."kind" = 'despesa'
        AND "cash_movements"."direction" = 'out'
        AND "cash_movements"."order_id" IS NULL
        AND "cash_movements"."payment_method" IS NULL
      ) OR (
        "cash_movements"."kind" = 'sangria'
        AND "cash_movements"."direction" = 'out'
        AND "cash_movements"."order_id" IS NULL
        AND "cash_movements"."payment_method" IS NULL
        AND "cash_movements"."expense_category_id" IS NULL
      ) OR (
        "cash_movements"."kind" = 'suprimento'
        AND "cash_movements"."direction" = 'in'
        AND "cash_movements"."order_id" IS NULL
        AND "cash_movements"."payment_method" IS NULL
        AND "cash_movements"."expense_category_id" IS NULL
      )

catalog_items_kind_shape.name: catalog_items_kind_shape
catalog_items_kind_shape.value:
(
        "catalog_items"."kind" = 'service'
        AND "catalog_items"."duration_minutes" IS NOT NULL
        AND "catalog_items"."sku" IS NULL
        AND "catalog_items"."stock" IS NULL
        AND "catalog_items"."gtin14" IS NULL
        AND "catalog_items"."reconciliation_pending" IS NULL
        AND "catalog_items"."reconciliation_last_attempt" IS NULL
      ) OR (
        "catalog_items"."kind" = 'product'
        AND "catalog_items"."duration_minutes" IS NULL
        AND "catalog_items"."stock" IS NOT NULL
      )

invites_acceptance_consistency.name: invites_acceptance_consistency
invites_acceptance_consistency.value:
(
        "invites"."status" = 'accepted'
        AND "invites"."accepted_by_uid" IS NOT NULL
        AND "invites"."accepted_at" IS NOT NULL
      ) OR (
        "invites"."status" = 'pending'
        AND "invites"."accepted_by_uid" IS NULL
        AND "invites"."accepted_at" IS NULL
      ) OR "invites"."status" IN ('expired', 'revoked')

orders_status_shape.name: orders_status_shape
orders_status_shape.value:
(
        "orders"."status" = 'open'
        AND "orders"."closed_at" IS NULL
        AND "orders"."payment_method" IS NULL
      ) OR (
        "orders"."status" = 'cancelled'
        AND "orders"."closed_at" IS NULL
        AND "orders"."payment_method" IS NULL
      ) OR (
        "orders"."status" = 'closed'
        AND "orders"."closed_at" IS NOT NULL
      )

units_address_complete.name: units_address_complete
units_address_complete.value:
char_length(btrim("units"."address" ->> 'postalCode')) > 0
        AND char_length(btrim("units"."address" ->> 'state')) > 0
        AND char_length(btrim("units"."address" ->> 'city')) > 0
        AND char_length(btrim("units"."address" ->> 'neighborhood')) > 0
        AND char_length(btrim("units"."address" ->> 'street')) > 0

users_anonymized_pii_scrubbed.name: users_anonymized_pii_scrubbed
users_anonymized_pii_scrubbed.value: "users"."anonymized_at" IS NULL OR ("users"."whatsapp" IS NULL AND "users"."birth_date" IS NULL)

users_completed_profile_complete.name: users_completed_profile_complete
users_completed_profile_complete.value: "users"."completion_completed" = false OR "users"."anonymized_at" IS NOT NULL OR ("users"."whatsapp" IS NOT NULL AND char_length(btrim("users"."whatsapp")) > 0 AND "users"."birth_date" IS NOT NULL)
